lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Why did you tell us that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did you help him take her out to the fire?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: When he came back from the fire, he had put her on the fire, now you come back from the fire, or he does, what do you guys do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We start to clean up the blood.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: The jeep's still in the garage? Her jeep?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Okay, then whadda ya use to clean up the blood?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Was there a lot of blood on the floor? (pause) In your estimation, was there a lot of blood on the floor?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did her, did her clothes get pretty soaked with it?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Now those jeans that we took out of your house, were those the jeans you used that night?
